analyst.summary: Sarda Energy is a diversified metals-and-power business, not a pure steel story - roughly two-thirds of FY26 profit came from its thermal and hydro power operations, which cushioned a Q4 slowdown in steel realizations. The balance sheet is clean (net debt cut over 85% in the year) and the valuation (about 15.7x earnings) is reasonable for the quality on offer, but the pace of profit growth is already cooling quarter-on-quarter as the metals cycle softens, so we see this as a steady holding rather than a re-rating candidate.
